source.snippet: ERPNext Issue ID: ISS-2026-00134. Customer: Sushrusha Nursing Home (SNH). Raised By: support@cludotechnology.in. Issue Type: Feature Request. Sales Price should come automatically as MRP in 'Opening stock update' page. Status: Open.

problem_statement: Small businesses using ERPNext (especially healthcare and retail) must manually enter MRP/sale price when updating opening stock, causing data entry errors and wasted time during inventory setup and migrations.
target_segment: SMB owners and ERP implementation consultants deploying ERPNext for retail, healthcare, and distribution clients in emerging markets
notes: Signal comes from a paying ERP customer (nursing home) via a technology consultancy (Cludo Technology), indicating a real business context with money already spent on ERP implementation. ERP consultants frequently sell customisations and plugins to bridge gaps like this — a niche but monetisable opportunity (Frappe marketplace, custom app). Single instance; signal_strength 2 pending corroboration from ERPNext forums or GitHub.
